name: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN)
short: Human safety data are short-term: a 60-day trial in 80 healthy middle-aged adults found no safety issues; reviews say most research is in cells or animals and proper safety studies are needed.
text: In a 60-day randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in 80 healthy middle-aged adults taking NMN by mouth at up to 900 mg daily, no safety issues were found on monitoring of adverse events, laboratory and clinical measures, and NMN was well tolerated. A systematic review of 33 human intervention studies of NAD-related compounds found that oral nicotinamide riboside and NMN were generally well tolerated over weeks to months, but that clinical benefits were inconclusive. Reviews of NMN as an anti-aging product caution that most studies have been in cell or animal models, that concern remains about the safety of NMN supplementation in people, and that proper clinical investigations of safety are needed. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.
